script.title: Endor-928: Ewok Classic Space Canopy Outpost & Timber-Wing Explorer
script.description: A rich mash-up of late-1970s LEGO Classic Space (928 Galaxy Explorer, 926 Command Center, 920 Alpha-1 Rocket Base, 886 Space Buggy, and 918 Scout Ship) re-engineered by Ewok spacefarers from giant hollow Sequoia trees, woven timber, thatch, bamboo, and glowing amber tree-sap crystals.
